purpose: Test whether crypto-derived VN hour filter is the portability bottleneck for WR v2.5.13 on TradFi.
timeframe: M15 from exact 3x contiguous M5 bars
core: Wave Rider v2.5.13 unchanged: pivot10/10+[1], EMA21, 12-bar regime, ATR-angle, CHOP14<50, signal range<=1.5ATR, next-bar stop entry, TP2.3R, EMA/session lifecycle.

session_policy.US_STOCK_CFD: Use the source regular-session bars; infer each UTC trading day close from the last available aggregated bar; no-entry 40m before close and forced-exit 15m before close. No overnight carry.
session_policy.FX_METAL_INDEX: Use all available weekday bars and retain the canonical WR UTC daily no-entry/exit lifecycle guard.

variants.T: No VN hour filter; admit only weekdays classified NORMAL or T+1; cluster-overlap days remain OFF.
variants.ALL: No VN hour filter and no T exclusion; admit every available weekday; retain T labels only for diagnostics.

discipline: No symbol/session-hour selection after viewing these outcomes. ASK/spread/commission exact execution is run only for preregistered-gate survivors.
